cues.text: The back alley behind Port Island Station. You walk in with Ken, past a group of rough-looking young people hanging around by the wall. The young people turn and stare at Ken.
Ken walks on past them, deeper into the alley, and you follow him until he stops and turns to you.
Some time later, you and Ken are back in the alley, and Ken is smiling.
Ken heads off down the alley, and you follow. He stops and looks back, his face falling.
